system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Animalism, Intermediate Obfuscate. Reaching back to when a wolf's howl echoed a message across the land, this power lets a Nosferatu send warnings and other quick, simple messages (roughly two simple sentences) on the voices of wolves.

System: The player relates the simple message (the Storyteller judges whether it's too complex — saying it in one breath is a good rule of thumb), then rolls Manipulation + Animal Ken (difficulty 6); successes indicate the distance the message travels (1: five miles; 2: 10 miles; 3: 50 miles; 4: 100 miles; 5+: 250 miles). A failure means there are no packs in the area (or they fail to pick up the message); a botch draws unwanted attention to the caller.

Costs seven Experience Traits to learn.

MET: Win a Static Social Challenge (retest Animal Ken) to relay a short message across the wilderness via relayed wolf howls; the Storyteller determines how far and how reliably it travels based on Traits bid and local conditions. Rumor holds that Lupines can also hear these missives.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Two: Lepers
